meta.siteTitle: Screenshot mockup generator for your app · Cover Studio
meta.siteDescription: Turn your app screenshots, or your website's address, into a ready-to-publish mockup for your README, Product Hunt or LinkedIn. Free, no account.
meta.ogImageAlt: Cover Studio: create the showcase image for your app
meta.appFeatures: Automatic layout from your screenshots, website capture from its address (desktop and mobile), multiple templates, brand color derived from your interface, PNG export in several formats (optional 2× resolution), images processed in the browser

landing.heroTitle: Screenshot mockup generator for your app's showcase image
landing.heroText: For your GitHub README, Product Hunt or LinkedIn: add your screenshots (or paste your website's address), pick a color, and download a ready-to-publish image. Nothing to design.
landing.startText: Import your desktop or mobile screenshots, or paste your website's address to capture it.
landing.step1Text: Drop in your screenshots, or paste your website's address and pick the pages to capture.
landing.step2Text: Choose a template, then the name, description, features and brand color.
landing.step3Text: A PNG ready for your README, Product Hunt, LinkedIn or social networks, in the size of your choice.
landing.destinationsText: Each page opens the editor in the right format and explains the platform's rules.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. It is an open-source project under the MIT license: no account, no watermark and no export limit.
faq.q2: Are my screenshots sent to a server?
faq.a2: No. Import, layout and PNG export all happen in your browser. No image is ever uploaded. The one optional exception: if you capture your site from its address, that address is sent to our capture service, which sends the images back.
faq.a3: PNG files: 2400 × 1500 for a cover, or Open Graph, GitHub, X / Twitter, Product Hunt and square formats, with an optional 2× high-resolution mode.
faq.q4: Can I self-host it or contribute?
faq.a4: Yes. The site is fully static: clone the GitHub repository, run the build and host the generated folder anywhere. Contributions are welcome.
faq.q5: Can I capture my website directly?
faq.a5: Yes. Paste its address: Cover Studio lists its pages, you pick 2 (captured on desktop and mobile) or up to 5 on a single device, and the screenshots land in the gallery. Pages behind a login and sites that block robots can't be captured: import your screenshots instead.
faq.q6: Can I make App Store or Google Play screenshots?
faq.a6: No. Cover Studio makes one showcase image (README, Product Hunt, link previews), not the series of screenshots at the sizes each store requires. Use a dedicated tool for those.
